<!-- The two fields below resolve most issues immediately. Please fill them in. -->

**Build number**
<!-- The chip next to "Amino Acid Colorizer" in the task pane header, e.g. "build 4".
     If it is older than the latest in CHANGELOG.md, quit PowerPoint with Cmd-Q and
     reopen — PowerPoint caches add-in code, and a stale build explains most
     "the fix didn't work" reports. -->

**Diagnose output**
<!-- Click Diagnose in the task pane and paste the JSON block here. It reports what
     the add-in actually sees: shape types, table dimensions, cells considered,
     which write path was used, and sample cell contents. Without it, "nothing got
     colored" has at least four indistinguishable causes. -->

```json

```

**What you did**
<!-- Which button, what was selected, whether a region was picked in the grid. -->

**What you expected vs what happened**
<!-- A screenshot of the table is very helpful. -->

**PowerPoint version**
<!-- PowerPoint > About PowerPoint. Table support needs Mac 16.100+ / Windows 2508+. -->
